raw:
SELECT SUM(r.points) 
FROM main.results r
JOIN main.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN main.races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.driverRef = 'button' 
  AND ra.year = 2009
  AND ra.date <= DATE '2009-07-01'
sql:
SELECT SUM(r.points) 
FROM main.results r
JOIN main.drivers d ON r.driverId = d.driverId
JOIN main.races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
WHERE d.driverRef = 'button' 
  AND ra.year = 2009
  AND ra.date <= DATE '2009-07-01'
